response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, team leadership, or mobile platform experience — key requirements for this Engineering Productivity Manager role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership through open-source projects and workshops
Broad stack expertise across mobile, web, and embedded systems with strong testing focus
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership experience
Limited demonstrable experience with mobile platform ecosystems (iOS/Android)
No mention of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change initiatives
